primary_source.authors: Chan-Ho Kim; appendix in collaboration with Robert Pollack
primary_source.title: The refined Tamagawa number conjectures for GL_2

verified_theorem_cells.statement: If the central Kurihara-number collection is nonzero and the p-adic representation has large image, then the Bloch-Kato Selmer group has the stated module decomposition; in particular cork_O Sel(Q,W_f^dagger)=ord(delta_min^dagger).
verified_theorem_cells.scope: newform; p>=3; large image; nonzero Kurihara collection

verified_theorem_cells.statement: Under large image and, in the (ord) branch, p>=5 with f good ordinary and p-distinguished, the central Kurihara collection is nonzero.
For good ordinary p>=5, p-distinguished f with large image, ord(delta_min^dagger)=cork_O Sel(Q,W_f^dagger), while complex analytic order agrees only modulo 2 with that Selmer corank.
For weight two with analytic rank <=1 and the stated technical hypotheses, exact Selmer corank, Mordell-Weil dimension, Kurihara order, and complex analytic order agree.
verified_theorem_cells.strict_disanalogy: rank <=1 cannot be promoted to analytic rank 2

verified_theorem_cells.statement: A verified nonzero individual Kurihara number delta_n gives cork_O Sel(Q,W_f^dagger)<=nu(n).
verified_theorem_cells.scope: large image; explicit nonzero discrete witness
verified_theorem_cells.strict_nonclaim: analytic rank two is not shown to produce an n with nu(n)=2 and delta_n nonzero

decisive_conjectural_boundary.statement: ord_{s=k/2} L(f,s) = ord(delta_min^dagger) under large image.
decisive_conjectural_boundary.importance_for_active_atom: For weight two, this is precisely the missing complex-Taylor-order -> discrete-Kurihara-order calibration needed to compose Theorem 1.1/Corollary 1.5 into exact Selmer rank from analytic rank two.
decisive_conjectural_boundary.consequence: The direct same-Q Kurihara route does not close the rank-two bridge; its missing edge is explicitly named by the source as a Beilinson-Bloch-Kato conjecture.

tests: Parity is rejected as exactness: analytic rank 2 is compatible with even Selmer coranks 2,4,6,... absent an upper bound.
Corollary 1.10 is rejected as a rank-two transfer because its hypothesis is analytic rank <=1.
Corollary 1.11 is not an analytic-rank theorem; a concrete nonzero delta_n witness is an additional discrete input.
The visual analogy between complex Taylor order and Kurihara order is rejected as theorem authority because the paper states the equality separately as Conjecture 1.6.
Theorem 1.1 is retained as a valid downstream exactness theorem and is not refuted by the failed root transport.

exact_chain_after_audit: MISSING: Kim-Pollack Conjecture 1.6 specialized to weight two would give ord(delta)=2
PROVED under Kim-Pollack theorem hypotheses: ord(delta)=cork Sel(Q,W)
PROVED under R12 coefficient binding: torsion Selmer corank equals dim_Qp H^1_f(Q,V_pE)

local_vs_gluing.local_mathematical_failure: NONE: Theorem 1.1/1.2/Corollary 1.5/1.11 are retained within exact source scope.
local_vs_gluing.root_facing_gluing_failure: The complex Taylor-order coordinate is not proved to equal the discrete Kurihara-order coordinate in analytic rank two; the source labels that equality Conjecture 1.6.
later_gluing_failures_kept_separate: exact Selmer dimension does not imply transverse loc_p != 0
Selmer rank does not by itself identify Mordell-Weil rank or close Sha/regulator/local-factor leading-term obligations

numerics_policy: Appendix computations and Corollary 1.11 may calibrate/falsify individual cases only; they do not prove a root-general analytic-rank-two transition.
